description: Power_curve_V2 BAIT/setpoint thermal comfort envelopes plus deadline-constrained causal EV V1G; V2G disabled.

parameter_status.thermal_power_envelope: Power_curve_V2 BAIT and balance-point formula with +/-1 C setpoint sensitivity; not an indoor-temperature calibration
parameter_status.thermal_state: province-generic equivalent thermal state; duration and retention require low/base/high sensitivity
parameter_status.thermal_compensation: central screening values bracketed by official provincial peak-reduction and load-increase payment caps
parameter_status.ev_v1g: uncontrolled charging baseline with aggregate 12-hour latest-service deadline; plug availability is not observed
parameter_status.ev_v1g_compensation: illustrative routine smart-charging value; must be sensitivity-tested from 0 to 600 CNY/MWh
parameter_status.v2g: disabled in the main comfort scenario; the 5 percent setting is a sensitivity assumption, not a policy mandate
